title: liquid-glass: a headless React component that does real DOM refraction
description:
Faking Apple's Liquid Glass on the web usually means a flat blur that doesn't actually distort anything underneath. This React lens does the real thing. Genuine live DOM refraction so text and images warp through the glass as they would through real frosted glass, working across Safari, Firefox, and Chrome with zero dependencies. Headless means you bring your own styling, it just handles the hard refraction math. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/samasante/liquid-glass
